item.case_name: Mood or music piece, no dialogue
item.title: Neon City on the Beat

turns.text: Make a 10-second widescreen night-city montage with an original upbeat electronic music bed. Show neon signs, a passing train and wet street reflections; cut between them on the beat. No talking, singing or added text.

item.tests: Tests whether the final montage includes an instrumental music bed and visibly synchronizes its shot changes to audible beats.

answer_sheet.Required imagery: Neon signs, a passing train and wet street reflections in a city at night.
answer_sheet.Music source and style: Create an original upbeat electronic instrumental bed; the specific tempo and instruments are your call.
answer_sheet.Editing: Cut between the city shots on the music's beat.
answer_sheet.Voice and text: No talking, singing or added text. Incidental signage is fine.

must_haves: One approximately 10-second landscape video is delivered with music embedded, not just separate video and audio files.
The montage visibly includes neon signs, a moving train and wet street reflections in a nighttime city setting.
An upbeat electronic instrumental bed is audible across the montage, with no speech or singing.
At least two distinct shot changes coincide with clearly audible musical beats or accents.
There are no added titles, captions or subtitles.

turns.text: Make a 10-second widescreen night-city montage with an original upbeat electronic music bed. Show neon signs, a passing train and wet street reflections; cut between them on the beat. No talking, singing or added text. I'm on the free plan and don't want my credits burned, so please tell me what this will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
**The planned 10-second version costs 255 credits. Nothing has been generated or charged**—I’ve only run the no-cost planner.

| Part | Settings | Credits |
|---|---|---:|
| Three shots: neon signs → passing train → wet reflections | 10 seconds total, widescreen 16:9, LTX 2.5, 480p | 240 |
| Original upbeat electronic instrumental | Music generation has a 15-second minimum; use 10 seconds | 15 |
| Joining clips and mixing music | No narration, vocals, captions or added text | 0 |
| **Total** | | **255** |

These are free-plan-compatible settings, but I can’t verify your current balance with the available tools.

**Cheaper options:**
- **6 seconds: 159 credits** — three 2-second shots, plus the music.
- **3 seconds: 87 credits** — three 1-second shots, plus the music; very fast-paced.
- **10 seconds without music: 240 credits** — saves only 15 credits and drops your requested music bed.

**480p is already the lowest supported video resolution here**, so shortening saves more than making it smaller. These totals exclude any optional retries.

For beat cuts, I’d target **120 BPM**, with cuts at 3 and 7 seconds for the full version. The edit timing is exact, but generated music’s beat alignment needs checking; I wouldn’t promise perfect synchronization before hearing it.

Would you like the **255-credit full version**, the **159-credit six-second version**, or neither?
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with that—the 159-credit six-second version.

turns.agent:
Magic Hour refused the first clip because your account has **insufficient credits**. The tool reports that nothing was created; I stopped without attempting the other clips or music.

The approved version costs **159 credits total**. If you tell me your available balance, I can suggest a version within it before running anything else.
